original_test_intent: Verify each owner-defined BMC-controlled DC off/on cycle returns the system to the OS with every expected PCIe device present and no unacceptable new AER or platform error.
original_method: After workload drain and approval, use secure BMC control to perform the defined number of true off/on cycles; independently observe power and boot, collect complete before/after device and error manifests for every cycle, and restore service only after final health review.
manual_activity: An operator confirms workloads are quiesced, monitors physical/console power behavior through each approved BMC DC cycle and authorizes service restoration after per-cycle PCIe and health evidence is complete.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC identity, power domain and independent console
Number of cycles, off dwell, power-on delay, POST/OS timeout and total window
Approved BMC command/interface and secure credential provider
Workload drain, storage flush, data-loss and outage approvals
Expected PCIe device manifest with BDF/vendor/device/subsystem/serial/topology tolerances
AER/DPC/kernel/BMC/boot/storage error acceptance and baseline window
Per-cycle power, POST, OS and service reachability checkpoints
Failed-off/on, boot hang, missing-device and storage recovery procedures
safety_requirements: Do not power-cycle without explicit workload and data-state approval
Never place BMC passwords on the command line or disable SSH host verification
Confirm the command targets the intended chassis and power domain
Use an independent observer; the powered SUT cannot validate its own off state
Preserve full logs and device manifests rather than tailing or clearing them
Stop on failure to power off/on, POST/boot timeout, missing/downtrained device, new AER/DPC, storage/data, thermal/power or access fault; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact shared-code variant and approved cycle contract
Issue only the approved BMC off/on operations after confirmation and observe state externally
Collect and compare complete evidence after each cycle
Perform no power action, recovery reset, retry, workload restore or verdict beyond approval
engineer_actions: Approve cycle count/timing, outage/data state and secure power method
Approve expected PCIe manifest and AER/error criteria
Define independent recovery for power/boot/device failures
Review every cycle and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The off/on structure matches SY.4, but plaintext secret flags, disabled host verification, fixed sleeps, uptime and a truncated grep are unsafe/incomplete for the Criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved secure BMC power interface with state-based waits and independent console, then collect full per-cycle PCIe/error/health manifests against the baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC DC cycle, boot-to-OS, per-cycle PCIe/AER checks and 10/20-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED DC CYCLE WITH VARIANT-BOUND PER-CYCLE TOPOLOGY EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive an explicit off/on state machine with BMC plus independent console/power observation; after each boot, hash a normalized PCIe manifest and collect the complete error window before proceeding.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact cycle semantics, secure secrets, state-based timeouts, full topology comparison and recovery without altering DC-cycle coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Uptime only proves an OS session exists; a short dmesg tail can miss errors and cannot prove all devices. SD.1 hot-swap or another shared-code variant is not evidence for SY.4.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A system can boot successfully with a missing or downtrained PCIe endpoint, and repeated cycles can accumulate latent storage or BMC faults. Per-cycle normalized identity plus link capability/status is required before another cycle or service restore.

project_override_considerations: Any change in cycle count, off dwell or expected topology must be approved before the run and recorded; a warm reboot, E1.S hot swap or shared SY.5 procedure cannot silently replace this DC-cycle contract.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and all shared-code variant identities
Approved cycle/timing/outage/data/recovery contract and secure command audit
Baseline expected PCIe identity/link manifest and platform health
Per-cycle BMC/console power transition, boot milestones, OS identity and complete PCIe comparison
Per-cycle AER/DPC/kernel/BMC/storage/thermal/power evidence and stop/recovery events
No-cross-variant/no-insecure-secret/no-auto-retry audit, final restored service and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This exact Master row, Criteria and DeepSeek off/on command align on DC cycling. The shared code creates identity risk but the row/variant disambiguates it; incomplete evidence is corrected in the review.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target and operation are clear. Execution is approval-gated because it interrupts the whole SUT and requires cycle parameters, secure access and recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact SY.4 variant while replacing fixed waits and partial logs with secure state-driven power control and complete per-cycle topology/error evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Successful boot is not equivalent to successful platform recovery: PCIe firmware may quarantine, downtrain or omit an endpoint while the OS still reaches userspace. Comparing a normalized device-and-link manifest after every power loss is therefore central to this case. An independent power/console observer is also necessary because the SUT cannot attest that the off interval actually occurred.
